name: January
title: Where to go on holiday in January
intro: Escape the grey with winter sun in the Caribbean or Asia, or go the other way for snow, huskies and the northern lights. Here's where's at its best in January.
seo_title: Where to go on holiday in January: sun, snow and northern lights

faqs.question: Where is hot in January?
faqs.answer: The Caribbean (Barbados, Grenada, Cancún), the Maldives, Sri Lanka, Thailand and Dubai are all warm and mostly dry in January. Cape Town and Sydney are in high summer. Closer to home, Tenerife is mild rather than hot, at around 20 to 22°C.

faqs.question: Where can we see snow or the northern lights in January?
faqs.answer: Tromsø and Rovaniemi have long dark nights for the northern lights, plus husky rides and reindeer. Chamonix and Whistler are in the heart of the ski season.

faqs.question: Is January a cheap time to go on holiday?
faqs.answer: Often, yes. Once the New Year week is over, flights and hotels in Europe drop to some of their lowest prices of the year. Long-haul winter sun stays in high season, so book those early.
